1933, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Blank Page
Sep. Pauline Rebeut - 55 - fears inward cancer .....
Anna Olendo - 54 - sugar-diabetis - three big favors - hopes for another.
Eleanore Bohr - 22 - Epileptic ..
Agnes LaBelle - 31 - serious eye-tr.
Mrs. Dettloff - 76 - trying to live on honest house rent. One renter owes 3 yrs .. refuses -
John F. Tighe - 9 - pneumonia yrs. ago - never got strength back - just able to walk.
Joseph Calley - 35 - widower with three small children, has ter- rible asthma & Hay.
Vera Kauffman - 35 - no cast necess.
DeWeisner - 36 - Coat. . . .
Carmina Moranto - 54 - work ....
Charlotte McCullough - 9 - badly swollen neck glands & neck ... 3 months ....
Sep. 20 Marg. Murphy - 54 - Enrolled in July as a hopeless cancer - report- ed O.K. now. Dr. had given her 3 - 6 month to live.
21
Mr. Ramby - about 45 - Appendicitis operation seemingly successful but now almost hopeless. Wife a non Cath. dispairing if ... Mr. Ramby reported improving. A neighbor, VanLoan, had operation same time as said Ramby. Van had been considered hopeless at time of operation - gangreenous appendix - astonished Drs. Now home O.K ...
Mabel Koebel - 35 - Glucoma infection ... Enrolled in S.MassAs'n ... Drs. including her husband surprised at improvement.
McCarly A.A ..... libel .... black male. Marie Glutting - 36 - like paralised
